entities.name: Adjudication Bodies Across Civilizations
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Formal bodies established to resolve disputes, interpret norms, and administer justice. Ancient Egyptian viziers, Athenian dikasteria, Roman praetors, Confucian magistrates, Islamic qadis, and English shire moots all developed structured processes for hearing cases and rendering binding decisions, creating the institutional foundation for the rule of governance that persists worldwide.
